text:
incident-bot: PAGER: sev2 - multiple decode/streaming nodes reporting CUDA OOMs and container restarts across us-west-2. Auto-quarantine triggered.

oncall_ryan: I'm on it. pulling logs now. which fleet?

eng_sre_kate: looks like decode-pool-4 and stream-pool-7. NVML shows repeated OOMs + kernel panic on frame 3.

ml_infra_lee: initial signal matches runaway generation from a small subset of requests (max_tokens unset on a client route). KV cache growth + continuous decode.

oncall_ryan: confirmed customer impact: spike in 5xxs and request drops. can we throttle the route?

eng_sre_kate: applying route-level limiter now:
```
PATCH /v1/routes/streaming-hr
{
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "concurrency_limit": 4
}
```

ml_infra_lee: pushing policy to edge. will also enable per-session hard cap kill (10m tokens) on the runtime.

deploy-bot: rollout started for route change to 6 nodes (canary 1/6).

oncall_ryan: rolling back a hot customer config that set max_tokens=0 (which we treat as unlimited) — deployed patch to treat 0 as default 1024.

eng_sre_kate: temporary mitigations: evicting long-lived KV sessions on pool 7, restarting affected containers to clear fragmented GPU memory.

ml_infra_lee: commands run:
```
# kill runaway sessions
curl -X POST $CONTROL/planner/evict -d '{"pool":"stream-pool-7","age_gt_s":600}'
# restart pods
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/stream-decode-pool-7
```

customer_ops_jamie: CS note: ~420 requests failed in the last 20m, hitting 3 mid-market customers (IDs redacted). We sent an initial status update.

oncall_ryan: telemetry confirms error rate dropping after throttles/restarts. still seeing 1-2 OOM per node during warm-up.

eng_sre_kate: added a temporary kernel fallback flag to use half-precision kernel variant on 3 nodes to reduce peak memory.

ml_infra_lee: log snippet:
```
E CudaError: out of memory at decode_loop.cpp:427
W Runtime: KV cache size growth 1.2GB/s for session 0x7f9c
I Eviction: session 0x7f9c evicted due to token cap
```

eng_sre_kate: action summary so far: route throttle, config patch for max_tokens=0, evict long sessions, restart affected pods, enable fp16 fallback on subset.

oncall_ryan: handing off to eng_sre_kate for follow-up and monitoring. I'll update pager and standby if it re-escalates.

eng_sre_kate: will own until metrics stable. immediate follow-ups: post-incident config lint to catch max_tokens=0, add telemetry alert for per-session KV growth >500MB/min, and customer compensation draft.

customer_ops_jamie: scheduling customer callbacks in 60m with engineering summary.

deploy-bot: rollout complete (6/6) for hotfix-route-patch.

eng_sre_kate: marking incident as contained. will open a short postmortem and include timeline + changelist. :white_check_mark:

oncall_ryan: thanks everyone. saving logs and traces to /incidents/6319802468 for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident closed to pagers at 63...6320172468. Recorded severity: sev2.
